key: 先看要复用谁的模型、要部署到哪，再看写法偏好。
Decide by whose models you reuse and where you deploy; coding taste comes last.

t: 要复现一篇新论文，官方代码和权重都放在 Hugging Face 上。
You are reproducing a new paper whose official code and weights are on Hugging Face.

pypi:torch: 新论文和开源权重大多直接以 PyTorch 发布。
Most new papers and open weights ship in PyTorch.
pypi:tensorflow: 多数情况要自己移植代码或转换权重。
You usually have to port the code or convert the weights.
pypi:jax: 研究圈有人用，但现成权重少，要自己转换。
Used in research, but ready-made weights are rare; expect conversion work.
pypi:paddlepaddle: 要转换权重，现成资源以自家模型库为主。
Needs weight conversion; its ready-made models are mostly in its own zoo.

t: 模型要在国产 AI 芯片（例如昇腾）上训练和部署。
The model must train and run on domestic Chinese AI chips such as Ascend.

pypi:mindspore: 华为自家的框架，对昇腾的支持最直接。
Huawei’s own framework, with the most direct Ascend support.
pypi:paddlepaddle: 适配了多种国产芯片，具体型号要查支持表。
Adapted to many domestic chips; check the support matrix for your model.
pypi:torch: 要装厂商提供的适配插件，可用版本受限。
Needs a vendor adapter plug-in, and only certain versions work.

t: 要把模型放进安卓手机 App 里离线运行。
The model must run offline inside an Android app.

pypi:tensorflow: LiteRT（原 TFLite）是移动端最成熟的运行时，TensorFlow 模型转换最直接。
LiteRT (formerly TFLite) is the most mature mobile runtime, and TensorFlow models convert most directly.
pypi:torch: 可走 ExecuTorch（已是正式版），也能转成 LiteRT 格式；算子覆盖要先验证。
Use ExecuTorch (now a stable release) or convert to the LiteRT format; verify operator coverage first.
pypi:jax: 要先转换成 TFLite 格式，多一道工序。
Must be converted to TFLite first: one more step.
pypi:paddlepaddle: 有 Paddle Lite，但近年更新很少，现状没有核实。
Paddle Lite exists but has seen few recent updates; its current state is unverified.
pypi:mindspore: 有 MindSpore Lite，但社区资料少。
MindSpore Lite exists, with less community material.

key: 看你想保留自己的训练循环，还是把循环交给框架。
Do you keep your own training loop, or hand the loop to a framework?

t: 已有一份手写的 PyTorch 训练循环，只想用最小改动跑到多张显卡上。
You have a hand-written PyTorch loop and want multi-GPU with minimal changes.

pypi:accelerate: 只要包几行，循环保持原样。
Wrap a few lines; the loop stays as it is.
pypi:lightning: 要把代码改写成它规定的模块结构。
The code must be rewritten into its module structure.
pypi:pytorch-lightning: 同上；这是同一个项目的原包名，两个包同步发版。
Same as above; this is the project’s original package name, released in step with lightning.

t: 新项目，想要现成的检查点、日志和早停，少写样板代码。
A new project that wants checkpoints, logging and early stopping out of the box.

pypi:lightning: 这些都内置，按它的结构写就行。
All built in once you follow its structure.
pypi:pytorch-lightning: 功能相同，仍同步发版；官方安装说明用的是 lightning。
Same features, still released in step; the official install docs use lightning.
pypi:accelerate: 只管设备和分布式，这些功能要自己写或另接。
Handles devices and distribution only; the rest you write or plug in yourself.

t: 要自己控制每一步反向传播（例如 GAN 的交替训练），不想被框架接管。
You need to control every backward step yourself (e.g. alternating GAN updates).

pypi:accelerate: 循环本来就是你自己的。
pypi:lightning: 支持手动优化，但要关掉自动优化并按它的钩子写。
Manual optimization is supported, but you must switch off automatic mode and use its hooks.

key: 先看硬件（有没有显卡），再看是自己用还是给很多人用。
Hardware first (GPU or not), then whether it serves you or many users.

t: 一台没有独立显卡的笔记本，想跑量化模型做本地体验。
A laptop without a discrete GPU, running a quantized model locally.

pypi:llama-cpp-python: 为 CPU 和 Apple 芯片上的量化模型而生。
Built for quantized models on CPUs and Apple silicon.
pypi:vllm: 有 CPU 后端，但对量化模型（GGUF）的支持还是实验性的，不适合笔记本体验。
Has a CPU backend, but support for quantized GGUF models is experimental; a poor fit for a laptop.
pypi:sglang: 已支持 CPU 和 Apple 芯片，但为服务端吞吐设计，笔记本上本地体验偏重。
Now supports CPUs and Apple silicon, but is built for server throughput; heavy for a laptop.
pypi:xinference: 可以调用 llama.cpp 后端来跑，但多了一层服务管理。
Can run it through a llama.cpp backend, at the cost of an extra service layer.

t: 一台多卡服务器，要给上百个并发用户提供 OpenAI 兼容接口。
A multi-GPU server exposing an OpenAI-compatible API to hundreds of concurrent users.

pypi:vllm: 连续批处理，高并发吞吐是它的主场。
Continuous batching; high-concurrency throughput is its home ground.
pypi:sglang: 同样为高吞吐服务设计。
pypi:lmdeploy: 性能不错，但支持的模型家族较少，先查支持表。
Fast, but supports fewer model families; check the list first.
pypi:llama-cpp-python: 能起服务，但高并发吞吐不是强项。
Can serve, but high-concurrency throughput is not its strength.
pypi:xinference: 它是调度层，吞吐取决于底下选的引擎。
It is an orchestration layer; throughput depends on the engine underneath.

t: 团队要在同一套服务里统一管理对话、嵌入、重排和语音模型。
One service must manage chat, embedding, rerank and speech models together.

pypi:xinference: 定位就是多类模型的统一部署和管理。
Its purpose is unified deployment of many model types.
pypi:vllm: 也能跑嵌入和重排模型，但一个进程只服务一个模型，统一管理要自己搭。
Also serves embedding and rerank models, but one model per process; unified management is on you.
pypi:llama-cpp-python: 服务端能配置多个模型按名路由，但内存里一次只留一个。
The server can route across several configured models, but keeps only one in memory.

key: 看硬件归属：跨平台、Intel、Apple，还是专跑 Transformer。
Follow the hardware: cross-platform, Intel, Apple, or Transformer-only.

t: 模型要同时发到 Windows、Linux 和手机上，硬件不统一。
The model ships to Windows, Linux and phones with mixed hardware.

pypi:onnxruntime: 覆盖的平台和硬件后端最全。
Covers the widest range of platforms and hardware backends.
pypi:openvino: 在 Intel 硬件上最好，其他硬件受限。
Best on Intel hardware; limited elsewhere.
pypi:ctranslate2: 只支持 Transformer 类模型，移动端不是目标。
Transformer models only; mobile is not a target.
pypi:mlx: 主要面向 Apple 芯片，现在也能跑在 Linux 上，但到不了 Windows 和安卓。
Mainly for Apple silicon, now also Linux, but it does not reach Windows or Android.

t: 只在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上跑模型，还想顺手微调。
Running and also fine-tuning models only on Apple-silicon Macs.

pypi:mlx: 苹果为自家芯片做的框架，推理和微调都支持。
Apple’s own framework for its chips; supports inference and fine-tuning.
pypi:onnxruntime: 能做推理，微调流程和社区模型不如 MLX 现成。
Fine for inference; fine-tuning workflow and community models are less ready than MLX’s.

t: 在 CPU 服务器上高吞吐地跑翻译模型或 Whisper。
High-throughput translation or Whisper on CPU servers.

pypi:ctranslate2: 专为 Transformer 的 CPU 推理优化，faster-whisper 就建在它上面。
Optimized for Transformer inference on CPU; faster-whisper is built on it.
pypi:onnxruntime: 通用可行，但导出和量化要自己做。
Works in general, but export and quantization are your job.
pypi:openvino: Intel CPU 上表现好，但要先转换模型格式。
Good on Intel CPUs, but the model must be converted first.

key: 先分清重点是流程控制、接入数据，还是类型约束。
First decide what matters most: flow control, data access, or typed outputs.

t: 流程有分支、循环和人工审批，要能中断后从断点恢复。
The flow has branches, loops and human approval, and must resume after interruption.

pypi:langgraph: 显式的状态图加检查点，支持中断和恢复。
Explicit state graph with checkpoints; supports interrupt and resume.
pypi:langchain: 它的智能体建在 LangGraph 上，能用检查点和人工审批，但自定义分支和循环仍要直接写 LangGraph。
Its agents run on LangGraph and get checkpoints and human approval, but custom branches and loops still mean writing LangGraph directly.
pypi:crewai: 要改用它的 Flows（路由、持久化、人工反馈）来写，按角色分工的 Crew 本身做不了。
Possible with its Flows (router, persistence, human feedback), not with role-based Crews alone.
pypi:llama-index-core: 有工作流机制可用，但持久化恢复要自己补。
Its workflows can do it, but durable resume is up to you.
pypi:smolagents: 极简的循环，没有内置的持久化。
A minimal loop with no built-in persistence.

t: 主要工作是把公司文档接进来做问答，检索质量是重点。
The main job is Q&A over company documents; retrieval quality is the focus.

pypi:llama-index-core: 数据接入、索引和检索器最齐全。
The fullest set of loaders, indexes and retrievers.
pypi:haystack-ai: Retrieval pipelines are its core business.
pypi:langchain: 能做，但检索组件分散在多个集成包里。
Possible, but retrieval parts are spread over many integration packages.
pypi:crewai: 重点在多角色协作，检索要外接。
Focused on multi-role collaboration; retrieval is bolted on.
pypi:autogen-agentchat: 项目已归档、停止维护（官方建议迁到 Microsoft Agent Framework），检索也要外接。
Archived and unmaintained (Microsoft points to its Agent Framework); retrieval is bolted on anyway.

t: 想让输出严格符合类型定义，代码还要能过静态类型检查。
Outputs must match type definitions and the code must pass static type checks.

pypi:pydantic-ai: 以 Pydantic 类型为核心，结果自带校验。
Built around Pydantic types; results are validated.
pypi:langchain: 支持结构化输出，但类型提示覆盖不完整。
Has structured output, but type hints are incomplete.
pypi:smolagents: 以生成并执行代码为主，输出类型不受约束。
Centers on generating and running code; output types are unconstrained.

key: 看你要一体化、要可控流程，还是只绑一家模型。
All-in-one, controllable flow, or tied to one model vendor?

t: TypeScript 全栈项目，想要自带工作流、记忆和评测的一体化框架。
A TypeScript full-stack project wanting workflows, memory and evals in one framework.

npm:@mastra/core: 定位就是 TypeScript 的一体化智能体框架。
Positioned as the all-in-one TypeScript agent framework.
npm:@openai/agents: 轻量，自带会话记忆，但工作流和评测要自己接。
Lightweight with built-in session memory; workflows and evals are yours to add.
npm:llamaindex: 项目已宣布弃用、不再维护，新项目不建议选。
Officially deprecated and unmaintained; not advisable for new projects.

t: 需要带循环的有状态流程，并能从断点恢复。
A stateful flow with loops that can resume from a checkpoint.

npm:langchain: 智能体建在 LangGraph 上，自定义的循环流程仍要直接用 LangGraph。
Agents are built on LangGraph; custom looping flows still need LangGraph itself.
npm:llamaindex: 项目已宣布弃用、不再维护，新项目不建议选。
Officially deprecated and unmaintained; not advisable for new projects.

t: 只用 OpenAI 的模型，想最快做出能互相交接任务的多个智能体。
OpenAI models only; you want agents that hand off to each other as fast as possible.

npm:@openai/agents: 官方出品，交接是内置概念。
The vendor’s own SDK; handoffs are a built-in concept.
npm:@langchain/langgraph: 能做，但要自己画图建状态，起步慢。
Possible, but you design the graph and state yourself: slower start.
npm:langchain: Handoff logic is yours to build.

key: 原生 SDK 功能最全但绑定一家；OpenAI 的 SDK 因为“兼容接口”成了半个通用件。
Native SDKs are complete but single-vendor; OpenAI’s became half-universal through compatible endpoints.

t: 想让同一份代码能连到本地推理服务和各家的“OpenAI 兼容”端点。
One codebase should reach local inference servers and various OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

pypi:openai: 改一个地址参数就能连各种兼容端点。
Change the base URL and it talks to any compatible endpoint.
pypi:anthropic: 用的是 Anthropic 自己的消息格式，连不了 OpenAI 兼容端点。
Speaks Anthropic’s own message format; it cannot reach OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
pypi:google-genai: Talks to its own service only.
pypi:mistralai: Talks to its own service only.

t: 应用部署在中国大陆，要调用通义千问，并用到它的专有功能。
Deployed in mainland China, calling Qwen including its vendor-specific features.

pypi:dashscope: 阿里云的原生 SDK，功能最全。
Alibaba Cloud’s native SDK with the full feature set.
pypi:openai: 可以指向阿里云的兼容端点，但部分专有功能只有原生 SDK 有。
Can point at Alibaba’s compatible endpoint, but some features exist only in the native SDK.
pypi:zhipuai: 调的是智谱自家的模型，不是通义；这个包也已被新的 zai-sdk 接替。
Calls Zhipu’s own models, not Qwen; the package is also superseded by the newer zai-sdk.
pypi:anthropic: 可以把地址指向阿里云的 Anthropic 兼容端点来调通义，但专有功能仍只有原生 SDK 有。
Can point at Alibaba Cloud’s Anthropic-compatible endpoint to reach Qwen, but vendor-specific features stay native-SDK only.

t: 要用 Claude 的专有能力（例如提示缓存），并拿到全部参数。
You need Claude-specific capabilities such as prompt caching, with every parameter.

pypi:anthropic: 原生 SDK，专有参数最全。
The native SDK exposes every vendor-specific parameter.
pypi:openai: Anthropic 的兼容层不支持提示缓存，官方也说它只用于测试对比。
Anthropic’s compatibility layer does not support prompt caching and is meant for testing only.

key: 两者不在同一种语言里：先看你写的是 Python 后端还是 JS 前端。
They live in different languages: Python backend or JS front end?

t: Python 后端要用同一套调用格式接多家模型，并统计各家费用。
A Python backend calling many vendors through one format and tracking cost.

pypi:litellm: Python 库，统一成 OpenAI 格式，自带费用统计。
A Python library that normalizes to the OpenAI format with cost tracking.
npm:ai: 是 JS/TS 库，Python 里用不了。
A JS/TS library; unusable from Python.

t: Next.js 应用要在页面上流式显示回答，想用现成的 React 钩子。
A Next.js app streaming answers to the page with ready-made React hooks.

npm:ai: 为这个场景设计，带流式和界面钩子。
Designed for this, with streaming and UI hooks.
pypi:litellm: 可以作为后面的网关，但页面上的流式界面要自己写。
Can sit behind as a gateway, but the streaming UI is yours to write.

key: 和 Python 一样：原生 SDK 功能最全，OpenAI 的 SDK 靠兼容接口通用。
As in Python: native SDKs are complete; OpenAI’s is universal through compatible endpoints.

t: 要连接自己搭的 OpenAI 兼容推理服务。
Connecting to your own OpenAI-compatible inference server.

npm:@anthropic-ai/sdk: 用的是 Anthropic 自己的消息格式，连不了 OpenAI 兼容端点。
Speaks Anthropic’s own message format; it cannot reach OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
npm:@google/genai: Talks to its own service only.

t: 需要 Gemini 处理上传的长视频和音频文件。
You need Gemini to process uploaded long videos and audio files.

npm:@google/genai: 原生 SDK，文件上传等能力齐全。
The native SDK, with file upload and the rest.
npm:openai: 兼容端点不支持文件上传，只能内联小文件，长视频传不上去。
The compatible endpoint has no file upload, only small inline files; long videos cannot be sent.

t: 要用 Claude 的提示缓存，并拿到全部参数。
You need Claude’s prompt caching with every parameter.

npm:openai: Anthropic 的兼容层不支持提示缓存，官方也说它只用于测试对比。
Anthropic’s compatibility layer does not support prompt caching and is meant for testing only.

key: 关键在能不能碰到模型的解码过程：能，就约束生成；不能，就校验加重试。
Can you touch the decoding step? If yes, constrain generation; if not, validate and retry.

t: 调用的是云端 API 模型，要得到符合 Pydantic 模型的结果，失败自动重试。
Calling a cloud API model; you want results matching a Pydantic model with automatic retries.

pypi:instructor: 就是做这件事的：校验失败把错误回给模型重试。
Exactly its job: on validation failure it feeds the error back and retries.
pypi:outlines: 强项是本地模型的约束解码；对 API 模型只能借用厂商自带的结构化输出。
Strong at constrained decoding for local models; with API models it can only lean on the vendor’s own structured output.
pypi:guidance: 对只开放 API 的模型，约束能力受限。
With API-only models its constraints are limited.

t: 本地开源模型，要求输出一次就符合 JSON Schema 或正则，不靠重试。
A local open model whose output must satisfy a JSON Schema or regex in one pass, no retries.

pypi:outlines: 在解码时约束可选的词元，从结构上保证合法。
Constrains tokens during decoding, guaranteeing valid structure.
pypi:instructor: 靠校验加重试，不能保证一次成功。
Relies on validate-and-retry; one-pass success is not guaranteed.

t: 要在一段模板里交替写固定文字和模型生成，并逐段限制取值。
A template interleaving fixed text with generated spans, each span constrained.

pypi:guidance: 交织式模板是它的核心用法。
Interleaved templates are its core usage.
pypi:outlines: 能约束单次输出，交织式模板不是主要用法。
Constrains a single output; interleaving is not its main style.
pypi:instructor: 面向“整段输出变成对象”，不管生成过程。
Aims at turning a whole output into an object, not at steering generation.

key: 先看规模和你愿意运维什么，再看功能。
Scale and what you are willing to operate come before features.

t: 做原型，不想起任何服务，数据就放在本地进程或文件里。
A prototype with no server to run; data lives in the process or local files.

pypi:lancedb: 嵌入式，数据就是本地文件。
Embedded; the data is just local files.
pypi:qdrant-client: 有本地模式，但只适合小规模测试，定位还是连服务端。
Has a local mode for small tests, but is meant to talk to a server.
pypi:pymilvus: 要额外装 milvus-lite 才有本地版，功能有删减。
The local edition needs the milvus-lite extra and has reduced features.
pypi:pinecone-client: 同上；这是 pinecone 的旧包名。
Same; this is the old package name of pinecone.
pypi:elasticsearch: 需要一套 Elasticsearch 服务。

t: 业务数据已经在 PostgreSQL 里，向量几百万条，不想多运维一套系统。
Business data already sits in PostgreSQL, a few million vectors, and you want no extra system.

pypi:pgvector: 向量和业务数据在同一个库里，事务和权限都沿用。
Vectors live beside business data, reusing transactions and permissions.
pypi:qdrant-client: 性能好，但多一套服务和数据同步。
Fast, but adds a service and data sync.
pypi:pymilvus: 为更大规模设计，这个量级偏重。
Designed for larger scale; heavy for this size.
pypi:pinecone: 免运维，但数据要同步到外部并付费。
No operations, but data is synced out and billed.
pypi:chromadb: 多一套存储，和业务数据的同步要自己做。
Another store; syncing with business data is on you.

t: 十亿级向量，需要分布式扩展和多种索引类型。
Billions of vectors needing distributed scaling and several index types.

pypi:pymilvus: Milvus 就是为这个量级的分布式场景设计的。
Milvus is designed for distributed deployments at this scale.
pypi:qdrant-client: 支持分布式部署，这个量级要仔细规划分片。
Supports distributed mode; this scale needs careful shard planning.
pypi:pinecone: 托管可扩展，要权衡费用和可控性。
Managed and scalable; weigh cost against control.
pypi:pgvector: 没有原生的分布式，索引也只有两种。
No native distribution, and only two index types.
pypi:chromadb: 以轻量起家，这个规模的生产案例少。
Began as a lightweight store; few production cases at this scale.

key: 看内存：放得下就用图索引，放不下就要压缩。
Memory decides: a graph index if vectors fit, compression if they do not.

t: 上亿条向量，内存放不下原始向量，需要压缩存储。
Hundreds of millions of vectors that do not fit in memory uncompressed.

pypi:faiss-cpu: 有乘积量化等多种压缩索引。
Offers product quantization and other compressed indexes.
pypi:hnswlib: 只有 HNSW 一种索引，不做向量压缩。

t: 几十万条向量，要边查询边增量添加，依赖越少越好。
A few hundred thousand vectors, added incrementally while querying, minimal dependencies.

pypi:faiss-cpu: 能做，但库更重，部分索引要先训练才能添加。
Works, but the library is heavier and some indexes must be trained before adding.

key: 三件事先问清：许可证、速度、要不要表格。
Three questions first: license, speed, and whether you need tables.

t: 闭源商业产品，依赖里不能有 AGPL 许可证。
A closed-source commercial product that cannot depend on AGPL code.

pypi:pymupdf: AGPL 许可证，闭源商用要另买商业许可。
AGPL; closed commercial use needs a paid license.

t: 上万份 PDF 批量提取文字，速度优先。
Extracting text from tens of thousands of PDFs; speed first.

pypi:pymupdf: 底层是 C 实现，速度快。
pypi:pypdf: 纯 Python 实现，明显更慢。
pypi:pdfminer-six: 纯 Python 实现，明显更慢。
pypi:pdfplumber: 建在 pdfminer.six 之上，更慢。

t: 要从财务报表 PDF 里把表格按行列抽出来。
Extracting tables, row by column, from financial-statement PDFs.

pypi:pdfplumber: 按线条和字符位置定位表格，参数可调。
Finds tables from lines and character positions, with tunable settings.
pypi:pdfminer-six: 给出字符坐标，表格要自己拼。
Gives character coordinates; you assemble the table.
pypi:pypdf: 只给文本流，没有表格结构。
Text stream only; no table structure.

t: 要在浏览器网页里显示 PDF，并让用户选中文字。
Showing PDFs in a web page with selectable text.

npm:pdfjs-dist: 浏览器里渲染 PDF 的事实标准。
The de facto standard for rendering PDFs in browsers.
npm:pdf-parse: 是提取库（文字、图片、表格），不提供可选中文字的页面显示。
An extraction library (text, images, tables); it gives no on-page viewer with selectable text.

key: 在“轻快”和“还原版面”之间选一头，另外留意许可证。
Pick between light-and-fast and layout fidelity, and mind the license.

t: 把一堆 Office 文档和网页快速转成 Markdown 喂给大模型，要求安装轻、速度快。
Quickly turning Office files and web pages into Markdown for an LLM; light install, fast.

pypi:unstructured: 能做，但依赖重，输出是元素列表，还要再拼。
Works, but heavy, and outputs element lists you must reassemble.
pypi:docling: 质量高，但要跑版面模型，较慢较重。
High quality, but runs layout models: slower and heavier.
pypi:marker-pdf: 以 PDF 为主，也要跑模型。

t: 扫描版论文 PDF，有复杂表格、公式和多栏排版，要尽量还原结构。
Scanned paper PDFs with complex tables, formulas and multi-column layout to preserve.

pypi:docling: 用版面和表格模型还原结构。
Uses layout and table models to recover structure.
pypi:marker-pdf: 用模型还原版面，公式和表格是重点。
Model-based layout recovery, with a focus on formulas and tables.
pypi:markitdown: 对复杂版面只做简单文本抽取。
Only simple text extraction on complex layouts.
pypi:unstructured: 高精度策略可用但慢，公式还原有限。
Its high-resolution strategy works but is slow; formula recovery is limited.

t: 闭源商业产品，需要宽松的许可证。
A closed-source commercial product needing a permissive license.

pypi:marker-pdf: 代码是 Apache-2.0，但模型权重另有许可：融资或营收超过 500 万美元的公司商用要另买授权。
Code is Apache-2.0, but the model weights have their own licence: companies above $5M in funding or revenue need a paid licence.

key: 先看语言，再看要几种浏览器，最后看要不要自带浏览器。
Language first, then how many browsers, then whether a browser is bundled.

t: Python 项目，要同时测 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit。
A Python project testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

pypi:playwright: 一套接口驱动三种内核，浏览器随装。
One API for three engines, browsers installed alongside.
pypi:selenium: 能驱动多种浏览器，但 WebKit 只能通过真正的 Safari，需要 macOS。
Drives many browsers, but WebKit only through real Safari on macOS.
npm:puppeteer: 是 JS 库，Python 项目里用不了。
A JS library; unusable in a Python project.

t: Node 服务里只需要驱动 Chrome 生成网页截图和 PDF。
A Node service that only drives Chrome to make screenshots and PDFs.

npm:puppeteer: 专注 Chrome，安装即带浏览器。
npm:playwright: 能做，但会带上多浏览器的体量。
npm:puppeteer-core: 不带浏览器，要自己提供 Chrome。
No bundled browser; you supply Chrome.

t: 部署到无服务器函数，包体积有上限，浏览器由平台或远端提供。
Deployed to serverless functions with a size limit; the browser is provided remotely.

npm:puppeteer: 安装时默认下载一份 Chrome，体积大。
Downloads Chrome on install by default; large.

key: 同步脚本、异步服务、HTTP/2 三个条件就能定下来。
Three conditions settle it: sync script, async service, HTTP/2.

t: 异步服务里要并发发出上千个请求。
An async service firing thousands of concurrent requests.

pypi:httpx: 同步和异步两套接口都有；注意原包近两年没有发版，后继是 httpx2。
Offers both sync and async APIs; note no release in two years, with httpx2 as the maintained successor.
pypi:requests: 只有同步接口，要靠线程池。
Sync only; you would need a thread pool.

t: 写一个一次性的小脚本抓几个接口，越省事越好。
A throwaway script hitting a few endpoints; least effort wins.

pypi:requests: The simplest, with the most material.
pypi:aiohttp: 必须写异步代码，小脚本里显得多余。
Forces async code, overkill for a small script.

t: 对方接口要求使用 HTTP/2。
The remote API requires HTTP/2.

pypi:httpx: 可选启用 HTTP/2；注意原包近两年没有发版，后继是 httpx2。
HTTP/2 can be switched on; note no release in two years, with httpx2 as the maintained successor.
pypi:aiohttp: Its client does not support HTTP/2.

key: 看你要的是接口、整套后台，还是一层薄壳。
An API, a full back office, or a thin shell?

t: 给模型包一层 JSON 接口，要自动校验请求体并生成接口文档。
Wrapping a model in a JSON API with automatic request validation and docs.

pypi:fastapi: 类型标注即校验，文档自动生成。
Type hints become validation; docs are generated.
pypi:flask: 校验和文档都要另装扩展。
Validation and docs both need extensions.
pypi:django: 要再加一层接口框架，偏重。
Needs an API layer on top; heavy for this.
pypi:starlette: 是 FastAPI 的底座，校验和文档要自己加。
It is FastAPI’s base; validation and docs are yours to add.

t: 要带后台管理界面、用户权限和数据库迁移的内容管理系统。
A content system with admin UI, user permissions and database migrations.

pypi:fastapi: 这些都要自己选库拼装。
Each must be chosen and assembled yourself.

t: 只需要一层很薄的 ASGI，挂几个路由和 WebSocket，依赖越少越好。
A very thin ASGI layer with a few routes and WebSockets; fewest dependencies.

pypi:starlette: 本身就是轻量的 ASGI 工具箱。
It is the lightweight ASGI toolkit itself.
pypi:fastapi: 建在 Starlette 上，多带一层数据校验。
Built on Starlette, adding a validation layer.
pypi:flask: 从 WSGI 起家，WebSocket 要靠扩展。
WSGI in origin; WebSockets need extensions.

key: 看运行在哪：传统 Node 服务器，还是边缘运行时。
Where does it run: a classic Node server or an edge runtime?

t: 要部署到 Cloudflare Workers 这类边缘运行时。
Deploying to an edge runtime such as Cloudflare Workers.

npm:hono: 基于 Web 标准接口，多种运行时都能跑。
Built on Web-standard APIs; runs on many runtimes.
npm:express: 靠 Workers 的 Node 兼容层运行，部分服务器选项不支持。
Runs on Workers’ Node compatibility layer, with some server options unsupported.
npm:fastify: 没有找到官方的 Workers 支持说明，能否跑通要自己验证。
No official Workers support statement was found; verify it yourself.
npm:koa: 靠 Workers 的 Node 兼容层运行，部分服务器选项不支持。
Runs on Workers’ Node compatibility layer, with some server options unsupported.

t: 团队要找最多的现成中间件和教程，稳定第一。
The team wants the most ready-made middleware and tutorials; stability first.

npm:express: 用的人最多，中间件和资料最全。
The most widely used, with the most middleware and material.
npm:fastify: 插件体系自成一套，资料少于 Express。
Its own plugin system; less material than Express.
npm:hono: 较新，Node 上的周边积累少。
Newer; less accumulated around it on Node.

t: Node 上的高吞吐 JSON 接口，想要内置的请求校验。
A high-throughput JSON API on Node with built-in request validation.

npm:fastify: 内置基于 JSON Schema 的校验和序列化。
Built-in JSON Schema validation and serialization.

key: 看要展示的是模型的输入输出、数据看板，还是一段对话。
Are you showing model inputs/outputs, a data dashboard, or a conversation?

t: 给一个模型函数包上输入输出控件，分享到 Hugging Face Spaces。
Wrapping a model function with input/output widgets and sharing it on Hugging Face Spaces.

pypi:gradio: 为模型演示设计，和 Spaces 配合最紧。
Designed for model demos, tightly tied to Spaces.
pypi:streamlit: 也能托管，但输入输出控件要自己排。
Hostable too, but you lay out the widgets yourself.
pypi:chainlit: 专做对话界面，不适合通用的输入输出演示。
Chat-only; not for generic input/output demos.

t: 做一个带图表和筛选器的数据看板。
A data dashboard with charts and filters.

pypi:streamlit: 脚本式写法，图表和筛选控件现成。
Script-style, with charts and filter widgets ready.
pypi:gradio: 能画图，但看板式布局和数据交互不是强项。
Can plot, but dashboards are not its strength.

t: 做一个能显示智能体中间步骤和工具调用过程的聊天界面。
A chat UI that shows an agent’s intermediate steps and tool calls.

pypi:chainlit: Step display is a built-in concept.
pypi:gradio: 聊天组件能折叠显示思考和工具调用，但消息要自己按格式组装。
Its chatbot can show collapsible thoughts and tool calls, but you assemble the messages yourself.
pypi:streamlit: 有聊天组件，步骤展示要自己写。
Has chat elements; step display is written by you.

key: 看数据量有没有超过内存，以及下游认不认 pandas。
Does the data exceed memory, and does the downstream only accept pandas?

t: 单机处理几十 GB 的 Parquet，内存放不下。
Tens of GB of Parquet on one machine, larger than memory.

pypi:polars: 惰性执行加流式处理，自动用满多核。
Lazy execution with streaming, using all cores.
pypi:pandas: 默认全部读进内存，要自己分块处理。
Loads everything into memory by default; chunking is on you.

t: 数据要交给一批只接受 pandas 的第三方库。
The data is handed to third-party libraries that only accept pandas.

pypi:polars: 交出去之前要先转成 pandas。
Must convert to pandas before handing over.

key: 看规则写在哪：写在 Python 类型里，还是写在一份 JSON Schema 里。
Where do the rules live: in Python types or in a JSON Schema file?

t: 用 Python 类型标注定义数据模型，解析后要拿到带类型的对象。
Models defined with Python type hints; parsing should return typed objects.

pypi:pydantic: 类型标注就是模型定义。
Type hints are the model definition.
pypi:jsonschema: 只判断合不合规，不产出带类型的对象。
Only says valid or not; returns no typed objects.

t: 手里是一份外部给的 JSON Schema 文件，要校验数据是否符合。
You hold an external JSON Schema file and must check data against it.

pypi:pydantic: 要先把 Schema 转成模型代码。
The schema must first be turned into model code.

key: typer 源自 click（现在自带一份它的源码）：要省事选 typer，要少依赖选 click。
Typer grew out of Click (now vendored inside it): Typer for convenience, Click for fewer dependencies.

t: 想直接用函数的类型标注生成命令行参数，少写声明。
Generating CLI options straight from function type hints, with less declaration.

pypi:typer: 函数签名就是命令定义。
The function signature is the command.
pypi:click: 每个参数都要用装饰器声明。
Every option is declared with a decorator.

t: 写一个被很多人依赖的库，要把依赖减到最少。
A widely depended-on library that must minimize its own dependencies.

pypi:typer: 自带一份 Click 源码，另外还依赖 pydantic、rich 等，比 click 重。
Vendors Click and also pulls in pydantic, rich and others; heavier than Click.

key: 看数据能不能出内网，以及要不要多人协作和模型版本管理。
Can data leave your network, and do you need collaboration and model versioning?

t: 数据不能出内网，要自己部署，而且要完全开源。
Data cannot leave the intranet; self-hosted and fully open source.

pypi:mlflow: Open source; you host the server.
pypi:wandb: 服务端不开源，自托管必须申请许可证才能启动。
The server is not open source; self-hosting will not start without a licence.

t: 多人团队要在网页上协作对比上百次实验、写报告、做超参搜索。
A team comparing hundreds of runs on the web, writing reports, running sweeps.

pypi:wandb: 协作、报告和超参搜索都是内置功能。
Collaboration, reports and sweeps are built in.
pypi:mlflow: 对比功能齐全，协作报告弱一些。
Full comparison features; weaker on collaborative reports.
pypi:tensorboard: 以单机查看为主，多人协作不便。
Mostly single-machine viewing; awkward for teams.

t: 除了记录指标，还要管理模型版本，并登记哪个版本已上线。
Beyond metrics, you manage model versions and record which is in production.

pypi:tensorboard: 只做可视化，没有模型版本管理。

key: 先分清要的是线上追踪，还是离线算指标。
Separate two needs first: production tracing or offline metrics.

t: 生产环境要记录每次调用的链路、费用和延迟，并且自己部署。
Production needs traces, cost and latency for every call, self-hosted.

pypi:langfuse: 开源的追踪平台，可自托管。
An open-source tracing platform you can self-host.
pypi:arize-phoenix: 源码公开（Elastic License 2.0，不算严格意义的开源），可本地或自托管运行。
Source-available under Elastic License 2.0 (not strictly open source); runs locally or self-hosted.
pypi:ragas: 是评测指标库，不做线上追踪。
A metrics library; it does not trace production.
pypi:deepeval: 以评测为主，线上追踪要配合它的平台。
Evaluation first; tracing relies on its companion platform.

t: 要给 RAG 系统算忠实度、上下文相关性这类指标。
Computing faithfulness and context relevance for a RAG system.

pypi:ragas: 这类 RAG 指标是它的本行。
These RAG metrics are its core.
pypi:langfuse: 能存分数和跑评测，但指标常要接别的库来算。
Stores scores and runs evals, but metrics often come from another library.

t: 想把对大模型输出的评测写成 pytest 风格的单元测试，放进 CI。
Writing LLM output evals as pytest-style unit tests in CI.

pypi:deepeval: 就是按单元测试的写法设计的。
pypi:ragas: 给出指标函数，测试怎么组织要自己写。
Gives metric functions; test organization is yours.
pypi:langfuse: 重点在平台上的追踪和评测，放进 CI 要自己接。
Focused on platform tracing and evals; CI wiring is yours.

key: 看要扩的是数据处理，还是训练和服务。
Are you scaling data processing, or training and serving?

t: 把 pandas、NumPy 风格的数据处理扩到集群，尽量少改代码。
Scaling pandas/NumPy-style data processing to a cluster with few code changes.

pypi:dask: 接口刻意贴近 pandas 和 NumPy。
Its API deliberately mirrors pandas and NumPy.
pypi:ray: 有数据处理模块，但接口不是 pandas 风格，改动更大。
Has a data module, but not pandas-style: more rewriting.

t: 分布式训练、超参搜索和模型在线服务要跑在同一套集群上。
Distributed training, hyperparameter search and online serving on one cluster.

pypi:ray: 训练、调参、服务都有配套库。
Has companion libraries for training, tuning and serving.
pypi:dask: 能调度任务，但训练和服务的配套要自己搭。
Schedules tasks, but training and serving tooling is yours to build.

key: 看语言和用途：中文分词、生产级流水线，还是教学。
Language and purpose: Chinese segmentation, a production pipeline, or teaching.

t: 只要给中文文本分词，用于关键词检索，越轻越好。
Just segmenting Chinese text for keyword search, as light as possible.

pypi:jieba: 轻量，装上就能分词；但 2020 年后没有再发版。
Lightweight and works out of the box, but no release since 2020.
pypi:spacy: 有中文模型，但要另外下载，偏重。
Has Chinese models, downloaded separately; heavier.
pypi:nltk: 没有内置的中文分词器。

t: 英文文本要做命名实体识别和依存句法分析，用在生产环境。
English named-entity recognition and dependency parsing in production.

pypi:spacy: 为生产设计的流水线，带预训练模型。
A pipeline designed for production, with pretrained models.
pypi:nltk: 偏教学和研究，生产速度和流水线不如 spaCy。
Oriented to teaching and research; slower and less of a pipeline than spaCy.
pypi:jieba: 只做中文分词和词性标注。
Chinese segmentation and POS tagging only.

t: 教学场景，要演示词干提取、经典语料和各种传统算法。
Teaching: demonstrating stemming, classic corpora and traditional algorithms.

pypi:nltk: 自带大量语料和经典算法实现。
Ships many corpora and classic algorithm implementations.
pypi:spacy: 面向生产，不带那么多教学语料。

key: 看任务：读写缩放、视频与实时视觉，还是科研算法。
The task decides: read/resize, video and real-time vision, or research algorithms.

t: 只需要打开图片、缩放、转格式，然后喂给模型。
Only opening, resizing and converting images before feeding a model.

pypi:pillow: 做的就是这些，多数模型库直接接受它的图像对象。
Exactly this, and most model libraries accept its image objects.
pypi:opencv-python: 可以，但体积大，默认 BGR 通道顺序容易踩坑。
Works, but it is large and its default BGR channel order is a trap.
pypi:scikit-image: 偏科研算法，只做读写缩放显得重。
Research-oriented; heavy for plain I/O and resizing.

t: 要读摄像头视频流并做实时目标跟踪。
Reading a camera stream and tracking objects in real time.

pypi:opencv-python: 视频采集内置；常用的几种跟踪器要装 opencv-contrib-python。
Video capture is built in; several common trackers need opencv-contrib-python.

t: 做科研，要用现成的分割、形态学和特征提取算法，直接配合 NumPy 数组。
Research work using ready segmentation, morphology and feature algorithms on NumPy arrays.

pypi:scikit-image: 算法齐全，图像就是 NumPy 数组，文档按算法讲解。
Broad algorithms, images are NumPy arrays, docs explain each method.
pypi:opencv-python: 算法也全，但接口是 C++ 风格，文档偏工程。
Also broad, but with a C++-style API and engineering-minded docs.

key: 同一个模型的两种实现：一个为了读和改，一个为了跑得快。
Two implementations of one model: one to read and modify, one to run fast.

t: 要在 CPU 或小显存的机器上尽快转写大量录音。
Transcribing lots of audio quickly on CPU or a small GPU.

pypi:faster-whisper: 基于 CTranslate2 重新实现，更快更省内存，支持量化。
Reimplemented on CTranslate2: faster, leaner, with quantization.
pypi:openai-whisper: 官方参考实现，同样的模型更慢、更占内存。
The reference implementation: slower and hungrier for the same model.

t: 想对照论文读官方实现，或基于 PyTorch 改模型做微调。
Reading the official implementation next to the paper, or fine-tuning in PyTorch.

pypi:openai-whisper: PyTorch 写的官方参考实现，适合对照阅读和改模型；训练脚本要自己写。
The official PyTorch reference, good for reading and modifying; the training script is yours to write.
pypi:faster-whisper: 模型已转成推理专用格式，不方便改结构和训练。
Models are converted to an inference-only format; hard to modify or train.

key: 一个是通用入口，一个是 BGE 系列的专用工具。
One is the general entry point; the other is the dedicated tool for the BGE family.

t: 想用同一套接口加载 Hugging Face 上各家的嵌入模型，并做微调。
One interface for embedding models from many authors on Hugging Face, plus fine-tuning.

pypi:sentence-transformers: 通用入口，多数嵌入模型都按它的格式发布。
The general entry point; most embedding models are published in its format.
pypi:flagembedding: 主要服务 BGE 系列模型。
Mainly serves the BGE model family.

t: 要用 BGE-M3 同时输出稠密、稀疏和多向量三种表示。
Using BGE-M3 to output dense, sparse and multi-vector representations together.

pypi:flagembedding: BGE 的官方库，三种表示一次给出。
The official BGE library; returns all three at once.
pypi:sentence-transformers: 加载同一模型默认只拿到稠密向量。
Loading the same model yields only dense vectors by default.

key: 把“抓取”和“抽取”分开看，再决定要不要自己维护浏览器。
Separate fetching from extraction, then decide whether to maintain browsers yourself.

t: 已经拿到 HTML，只想在本地抽出正文和元数据，不联网、不起浏览器。
You already have the HTML and want main text and metadata locally: no network, no browser.

pypi:trafilatura: 专做正文和元数据抽取，纯本地。
Dedicated to main-text and metadata extraction, fully local.
pypi:newspaper3k: 能做，但已多年没有更新。
Works, but has not been updated for years.
pypi:crawl4ai: 自带浏览器抓取，只抽正文显得重。
Comes with browser crawling; heavy for extraction alone.
pypi:firecrawl-py: 是抓取服务的客户端，要联网调用。
A client for a crawling service; it must call out over the network.

t: 目标网页靠 JavaScript 渲染，要抓成适合大模型的 Markdown，自己部署、不付费。
Pages rendered by JavaScript, crawled into LLM-friendly Markdown, self-hosted and free.

pypi:crawl4ai: 开源，驱动无头浏览器，输出 Markdown。
Open source, drives a headless browser, outputs Markdown.
pypi:firecrawl-py: 服务端可以自托管，但默认是付费云服务，这个包只是客户端。
The server can be self-hosted, but the default is a paid cloud; this package is only the client.
